title: dentaria cardiophylla
intro: Dentaria cardiophylla, commonly known as Heart-leaf toothwort, is a perennial plant species native to North America. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dentaria cardiophylla include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. Bioactive constituents of Dentaria cardiophylla include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
